tool_decision_reasons.no_protocol_neutral_contract: 当前没有 schema 与 handler 完整配套的协议无关 Tool 契约；该动作暂时只通过原生 UI/API 提供。
tool_decision_reasons.baseline_tool_contract: 对应的范围选择 Tool 属于系统固定基础能力的相关协议能力，必须通过独立 Tool Grant 授权，不能继承业务 Action。
tool_decision_reasons.binary_transport: 该动作需要先完成经过评审的二进制上传/下载传输契约，才能暴露为 Tool。
tool_decision_reasons.streaming_transport: 该动作依赖持续鉴权、游标回放和断线恢复的流式连接，不作为单次 Tool 调用暴露。
tool_decision_reasons.stateful_lease_protocol: 该动作依赖连接身份、租约续期和 fencing token 的有状态协议，不作为普通 Tool 调用暴露。
tool_decision_reasons.frontend_only_ungrantable: 该动作没有可独立强制执行的后端策略，因此不能暴露为 Tool。
tool_decision_reasons.human_interaction: 该动作有意保留为明确的人工 UI 交互。

exemptions.reason: Public single-use password reset completion entry.
Authenticated non-active account status and guidance route.
Authenticated context selection before a business page is entered.
Every admitted PM account can manage its own profile and login identities without a role or group grant.
Authenticated release announcement page rendered from runtime configuration; it calls no PM business API.

public_exemptions.reason: Deployment-pipeline release-note write authenticated by the AI_INTERNAL_SECRET HMAC signature; not a user-authorizable page action.
Deployment-pipeline read of the newest stored release note (version + release sha) authenticated by the AI_INTERNAL_SECRET HMAC signature; not a user-authorizable page action.
Public read-only version announcement feed backing the /release-notes announcement page.
Internal collaboration workload health probe protected by its dedicated service identity token.
Internal collaboration authority call protected by a dedicated service identity token and current resource policy evaluation.
Internal collaboration authority call protected by a dedicated service identity token and current resource policy evaluation.
Internal collaboration authority call protected by a dedicated service identity token and resource-scoped grant proof.
Internal collaboration mutation validation protected by a dedicated service identity token and resource-scoped grant proof.
Internal collaboration durable commit protected by a dedicated service identity token and resource-scoped grant and validation proofs.
External authorization-code exchange and refresh rotation are authenticated by one-time PKCE or a digest-backed refresh credential, not a PM session.
External token-family revocation is authenticated by the bound refresh credential, not a PM session.
Public OAuth authorization-server discovery metadata for the Tool issuer.
Public dynamic client registration validates its own software metadata and redirect contract.
